name: Viking® 5 Series 30" Stainless Steel Left Hinge Built-In Wine Cooler
shortDescription: Preserve, serve, and display up to 160 full-size bottles of wine in our state-of-the-art 30 inch wine column, a must-have for any bar or beverage operation aiming to provide a premium wine experience. Featuring dual zone independent temperature zones with a precise range, this unit ensures optimal storage conditions tailored to both red and white wines.

features.text: The sixteen full-width maple facing shelves, specially coated to reduce vibration, maintain the integrity of each bottle, offering a stable environment. With two convertible shelves designed for flexible bottle display, this wine column allows for customizable arrangements, making it perfect for showcasing your best selections. Enhance your establishment's appeal with this elegant and efficient wine storage solution, designed to meet the rigorous demands of restaurants and high-end bars.
Professional Features
Dual Zone Storage System provides two independent temperature zones
Preserves different types of wine at optimal serving temperatures
Settings are adjustable in each zone from 43 to 65 degrees F (6 to 18 degrees C)
Electronic control center constantly monitors and maintains the set temperature in each zone within 1 degree F (0.83 degree C)
16 shelves accommodate up to 160 full-size wine bottles horizontally, keeping corks moist
Stores standard, magnum, and half-size bottles
Full-width shelves pull out for easy access and are fully removable for easy cleaning
Exclusive – two convertible wine shelves adjust for bottle display, and are excellent for allowing bottles to settle before serving
Shelves are coated to reduce vibration and hold bottles snugly in place
Solid maple facings may be finished to coordinate with surrounding cabinetry
Ultraviolet-resistant tempered-glass and black interior protects wine from harmful light
Low-intensity interior lighting
Displays wine with minimal heat and light output
Turns on when door is opened to timed intervals
Keyed lock on door provides extra security
Easy Maintenance and Cleanup
Removable shelves and upper grille for easy cleaning
Power interruption switch completely turns off power to unit for safe cleaning and light tube replacement
Front-venting sealed refrigeration system works silently and efficiently
Adjustable-height lower kickplate removes to provide easy access to evaporator pan
Professional-Style Construction
Design and basic dimensions provide built-in appearance with standard cabinetry
Dual-magnet/spring-assist door seal system automatically closes wine cellar door
Door stops are factory set at 110 degree swing; easily adjust to 90 or 120 degree swing
Must be ordered either right- or left-hinge (specify R or L after model number)
